items.title: Destiny – Claude Code's fortune Teller skill
items.raw_excerpt: Destiny is the Claude Code's plugin that gives you a real fortune reading. Type /destiny to see today's destiny! It uses the actual classical East Asian astrology system. You enter your birthday once, then /destiny gives you today's reading anytime. Two layers, kept honest: 1. The numbers (your eight-character birth chart, today's day pillar, the hexagram for the moment, five-element relationships) are computed by a Python script. Same person + same day = identical output. You can verify against any traditional calendar source. 2. The prose (today's stars, character sketch, life arc, advice) is written by Claude, applying centuries-old reading conventions to that fixed data. Not LLM-hallucinated horoscope. If you have fun with it, a star would mean a lot.

excerpt_i18n.en: TTS Studio is an AI-powered text-to-speech tool that offers high-quality voice synthesis, supporting multiple languages and voice options.
excerpt_i18n.zh: TTS Studio 是一款基于AI的文本转语音工具，提供高质量的语音合成服务。用户可以通过该平台将文本转换为自然流畅的语音，支持多种语言和声音选项。

items.title: Open Design: Use Your Coding Agent as a Design Engine
items.raw_excerpt: Open Design is a new tool that lets users use coding agents as a design engine to generate UI designs from natural language descriptions. It leverages AI agents to automate code and design generation, aiming to speed up prototyping. The open-source project on GitHub has drawn attention from the developer community.

title_i18n.en: Open Design: Use Your Coding Agent as a Design Engine
title_i18n.zh: 开放设计：将你的编程代理用作设计引擎
title_i18n.es: Diseño abierto: usa tu agente de codificación como motor de diseño

excerpt_i18n.en: Open Design is a new tool that lets users use coding agents as a design engine to generate UI designs from natural language descriptions. It leverages AI agents to automate code and design generation, aiming to speed up prototyping. The open-source project on GitHub has drawn attention from the developer community.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Open Design 是一个新工具，允许用户将编码代理用作设计引擎，通过自然语言描述生成 UI 设计。它利用 AI 代理自动生成代码和设计，旨在加速原型设计过程。该项目在 GitHub 上开源，吸引了开发者社区的关注。
